findings.claim: The conformance validator is specified as read-only but instructs itself to run `npm ci`, which writes to the working tree.
findings.evidence: Acceptance criterion 1.3 requires `fhir-conformance-validator` to be `read-only`; the agent also says at line 22, `Use Bash only for verification and read-only commands. Never edit files`, but the command table includes line 35: ```.claude/hooks/** | `npm --prefix .claude/hooks ci && ...` ```, and `npm ci` installs/removes `node_modules` content.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace `npm --prefix .claude/hooks ci` with a non-mutating prerequisite check, or explicitly delegate hook dependency installation to a non-read-only setup step outside this validator.

findings.claim: The read-only conformance validator preloads a skill whose tool allowance and instructions include OpenSpec write/archive commands.
findings.evidence: Acceptance criterion 1.3 requires the conformance validator to be read-only, and `.claude/agents/fhir-conformance-validator.md` preloads `openspec-verify-change`; the skill frontmatter grants `allowed-tools: Bash(openspec:*)`, and its store-selection text says commands may `read or write specs and changes` including `new change` and `archive`.
findings.suggested_fix: Restrict the skill to read-only OpenSpec commands needed for verification, such as `status`, `instructions`, `list`, `show`, and `validate`, and remove/archive/write command guidance from this repo-resident skill.
